accessDeniedDescription: You need admin privileges to manage service accounts.
title: Service Accounts
description: Machine identities for CI/CD pipelines and automated systems. Each service account can have its own API tokens, independent of any human user.
noAccountsDescription: Create a service account to give CI/CD pipelines and automated systems their own identity and API tokens.
createDialogDescription: Service accounts are machine identities. The username will be prefixed with "svc-" automatically.
name: Name
tokensDialogDescription: Manage API tokens for this service account.
tokenCreatedDescription: Copy this token now. You will not be able to see it again.
createTokenDescription: Generate a new API token for this service account.
noTokensDescription: Create a token for this service account.
deleteDescription: This will permanently delete "{username}" and revoke all its tokens. Any pipelines using those tokens will lose access immediately.
revokeDescription: This will permanently invalidate this token. Any systems using it will lose access immediately.
